name: Quill Laurence
source:
Quill is a quiet man who is one of the central committee members of Nysa. He first moved into the Day Territories some fifteen years prior, after traversing the Trinity Desert. His view on humans ranges from frustration to exasperation to quiet indifference much of the time. He finds some of their behaviors equal parts baffling and entertaining.

Though he sits on the central committee, he spends much of each day working as a production editor for Brittia Publishing. He also writes android centric romance novels on the side.

[From in-game]
